vocab.example: I have a video interview with a company in Singapore on Friday morning.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi có buổi phỏng vấn qua video với một công ty ở Singapore vào sáng thứ Sáu.

vocab.meaning_vi: đường dẫn vào buổi phỏng vấn
vocab.example: Thank you for the interview link; I joined five minutes early.
vocab.example_vi: Cảm ơn anh/chị đã gửi đường dẫn phỏng vấn; tôi đã vào sớm năm phút.

vocab.example: I waited in the waiting room until the interviewer let me in.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi đợi trong phòng chờ trực tuyến cho đến khi người phỏng vấn cho vào.

vocab.example: Sorry, my microphone was off. Could you hear my last sentence?
vocab.example_vi: Xin lỗi, micro của tôi bị tắt. Anh/chị có nghe được câu vừa rồi không?

vocab.example: I use a headset because the audio quality is much better for interviews.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi dùng tai nghe có mic vì chất lượng âm thanh tốt hơn nhiều khi phỏng vấn.

vocab.example: I test my stable internet connection one hour before every online interview.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi kiểm tra đường truyền internet ổn định một tiếng trước mỗi buổi phỏng vấn trực tuyến.

vocab.example: If my screen starts to freeze, I will turn off the camera for a moment.
vocab.example_vi: Nếu màn hình của tôi bị đứng hình, tôi sẽ tắt camera một lát.

vocab.example: Good body language on camera means sitting straight and smiling naturally.
vocab.example_vi: Ngôn ngữ cơ thể tốt trước camera là ngồi thẳng và cười tự nhiên.

listening.title: An online interview for a developer position

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: Good morning, Nam. Thank you for joining. Can you hear me clearly?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: Good morning. Yes, the audio quality is very good on my side, thank you.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: Great. Sorry that you waited a few minutes in the waiting room.

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: No problem at all. I opened the interview link early to test my microphone.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: That is a good habit. Could you tell me about a difficult project you handled?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: Last year our payment service failed during a sale. My task was to find the cause.

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: I checked the logs, fixed the timeout setting, and wrote a short report for the team.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: And what was the result? Sorry, your screen froze for a second.

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: As a result, the errors dropped by ninety percent and we kept the client.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: Thank you, that was a clear answer. Do you have any questions for me?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: Yes. Could you tell me how the team works together when everyone is remote?

questions.q: Why did Nam open the interview link early?
What did Nam do when the payment service failed?
options: He asked a partner company for help
He checked the logs and fixed the timeout setting
He waited for the next release
Nam's screen froze for a second

shadowing: Thank you for the interview link; I can hear and see you clearly.
